sentence: This project offers elemental imaging analysis and free software to help scientists study biochemical pathways in human health and disease.
This project builds bioluminescence imaging tools for calcium, along with luciferases and luciferins that make light.
This project studies the structure of a proton-pumping enzyme complex and how it is regulated, including its role in human disease.
This project studies whether immune cells found in cerebrospinal fluid differ between patients with multiple sclerosis and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
This project tries to increase the number of research grants that investigators win from outside sources.
This project builds and tests a dashboard that flags unmet social needs of justice-involved Veterans at high risk of stopping opioid use disorder medications.
This project studies how cells that start metastasis work in metastatic breast cancer.
This project builds a prediction model that finds early bone loss patterns in radiographs to identify patients at high risk of periodontitis.
This project builds deep learning models that screen for glaucoma consistently across different populations of patients.
This project studies how the parasite Toxoplasma gondii enters a chronic state that resists current therapies.
This project studies how a protein called thrombospondin-1 harms the diaphragm and breathing in obese mice.
This project studies proteins released by astrocytes and tests whether Pleiotrophin slows disease in mouse models of Down Syndrome and Alzheimer's Disease.
This project uses polysomnography data, health records and machine learning to find types of obstructive sleep apnea and how they affect cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how a cell cycle protein helps oligodendrocytes make myelin, using zebrafish and mice.
This project tests and standardizes assays that measure anti-tumor immune responses in biopsy samples.
This project builds tools that automatically process and share human movement data so machine learning can predict how treatments change movement.
This project provides light and electron microscopes and image analysis tools for studying biological systems.
This project develops statistical methods that combine magnetic resonance imaging data from many sites so brain studies can be analyzed together.
This project builds human cell-based models of blood vessels in the outer retina to study how estrogen and androgen affect diabetic retinopathy.
This project builds research experiences focused on cancer health outcomes and computational biology.
